# BTicino C300X v1.9.8 — HTTPS callbacks

## 2026-10-15

This release adds verified HTTPS callbacks for Home Assistant installations that only accept HTTPS. It includes the integration and native agent `1.9.8-https.1`.

- Event subscriptions and the display bridge use the device's existing libcurl.
- TLS verifies the certificate chain and hostname. Redirects, environment proxies, and automatic HTTP fallback are disabled.
- Home Assistant preserves HTTPS hostnames and recognises HTTPS-capable agents.
- Existing HTTP callbacks, Smartphone forwarding, and video handling are retained.

## Installation

Install v1.9.8 in HACS and restart Home Assistant, then update the device agent through the integration. Use the HTTPS hostname and port of Home Assistant as the callback base URL.

## Validation

The ARMHF binary was built for Cortex-A9 / VFPv3 / NEON and checked against the C300X 1.7.19 firmware libraries. ABI and stack checks pass, as do 282 targeted tests. Nine tests requiring a local TLS server could not run in the build environment. HTTPS callbacks have not yet been confirmed on a physical C300X.

The release package contains the integration and agent; no device firmware is included.
